eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel Col H specifies 'Political Science' major rather than an AUC school code.

eligible_majors.notes: Excel scope specifies 'Political Science' (housed in School of International Relations at St Andrews per st-andrews.ac.uk); subject-specific exchange requires >=1 module/sem in exchange subject (Fact Sheet p.3).

excluded_majors.notes: Exchange and ISAP students cannot take evening courses or School of Medicine modules; 5000-level PG modules closed to UG.

min_gpa_host.notes: Minimum average grade 3.2/4.0 GPA for undergraduate exchange applicants (PG: 3.3/4.0 US GPA / UK 2.1 / Europe 2.2 or B+, p.1).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Non-native English speakers must meet official undergraduate English requirements at https://www.st-andrews.ac.uk/subjects/entry/language-requirements/undergraduate/ (accepted test tables hosted online; note unverified third-party IELTS 7.0 quotes excluded).

host_language_requirement.value: English only; non-credit English language support available (cannot satisfy entry requirement, p.3).

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Martinmas (Semester 1): Teaching Sep 14 - Dec 21, 2026 (2025-26 PDF pattern shows early-Sep Orientation & residence exit Dec 23).

tuition_model.notes: Official exchange students do not pay St Andrews tuition/programme fees (non-exchange ISAP students pay £11,975/sem or £23,950/yr in 2026-27).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived monthly cost from St Andrews official UG Cost of Attendance 9-month (38-wk) academic year budget divided by 9 months: University residence/utilities/food £12,208 + personal living expenses £3,800 = £16,008 / 9 = £1,778.67/month (~£1,779/mo; excludes ~£800 books/computer & travel). Note UKVI outside-London visa threshold is £1,171/mo (gov.uk).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate derived from monthly GBP range 1,779/month. ECB cross-rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD and 1 EUR = 0.83559 GBP -> 1 GBP = 1.322658 USD (2026-11-13, retrieved 2026-11-15 at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html); 5-month USD est = 1,779.0 GBP * 5 * 1.322658 = 11,765.05 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Student Visa (>6 mo) requires UK Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) for NHS care; Standard Visitor/ETA (<=6 mo) does not pay IHS (may incur non-emergency NHS charges — private medical insurance advised).

housing_availability.notes: Undergraduate exchange and study abroad students are guaranteed university accommodation if applying by Accommodation Services deadline (invitation arrives 48 hrs after offer acceptance).

housing_notes.value: University halls (£12,208 estimated 38-wk residence + food budget in 2026-27 per st-andrews.ac.uk Cost of Attendance); September confirmations issue in summer, January in December.

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: Note: China Scholarship Council guidance on p.2 applies to Chinese PhD/CSC candidates, not incoming AUC exchange.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Short-term <6 mo: Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) for non-visa nationals or Standard Visitor Visa. Longer >6 mo: UK Student Visa + Immigration Health Surcharge (NHS access).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Note: UKVI outside-London financial threshold is £1,171/mo (https://www.st-andrews.ac.uk/study/support/student-immigration/).

english_course_list_url.notes: All courses in https://www.st-andrews.ac.uk/subjects/modules/ are taught in English; no separate English-only URL.

credit_system_and_load.value: Scottish credit framework: standard full-time load is 60 credits (30 ECTS) per semester; 50-70 credits (25-35 ECTS) permitted with home university & Associate Dean approval (1 cr = 10 notional learning hrs).

course_restrictions_note.value: School of Medicine, evening courses, and 5000-level PG modules (for UG) are excluded; subject-specific Political Science exchange students must take at least 1 module per semester in Political Science/International Relations; 3000-4000 Honours modules require prerequisites.

academic_style.value: Traditional Scottish tutorial/seminar academic model with high independent workload (10 notional study hrs/credit) and compulsory matriculation; pre-advising 1 mo prior and online advising 1 wk prior.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: Not explicitly rated in Fact Sheet or st-andrews.ac.uk (UK English-speaking town & campus).

international_support_services.value: Global Office (weekly Tue-Thu drop-ins, Student Mobility Officer appointments, social events), Student Immigration Service, Pre-advising/Advising, English language support, and Student Services.

nomination_deadlines.value: For 2026 pattern (from 2025-26 partner sheet): January entry Nomination Sep 30, Application Sep 1 - Oct 31; September entry Nomination Apr 1, Application Feb 14 - Apr 15.
